title: AraMS-28k: The Largest Publicly Released Line-Level Dataset of Historical Arabic Manuscripts with Margin and Insertion-Anchor Annotations
abstract: arXiv:2608.26921v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce AraMS-28k, the largest publicly released line-level dataset of genuine historical Arabic manuscripts, comprising 14 books, 3,043 pages, and 28,600 annotated text lines (27,971 main-text, 629 margin). Thirteen books are hand-copied manuscripts spanning three script traditions -- Naskh, Ruq'ah, and Maghrebi -- and one is a lithographed printed edition included to broaden format diversity. Each line is labelled as main-text or margin, and margin lines that have an unambiguous attachment point in the main text are further annotated with an insertion anchor, recovering the manuscript's true non-linear reading order at line-level granularity -- to our knowledge the first such annotation released for a historical Arabic manuscript corpus. Because reference transcriptions are fully vocalised while manuscript hands are typically undiacritised, we release both the raw diacritised transcription and a diacritic-normalised counterpart

translated_title: AraMS-28k：最大公开的历史阿拉伯语手稿行级数据集，包含页边注释与插入锚点标注
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26921v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们推出了AraMS-28k，这是最大公开的真实历史阿拉伯语手稿行级数据集，包含14本书、3,043页和28,600条标注文本行（27,971条正文，629条页边）。其中13本书为手抄本，涵盖三种书写传统——纳斯赫体、鲁克阿体和马格里布体——另有一本石印印刷版以增加格式多样性。每行被标注为正文或页边，并且页边行若在正文中有明确的插入点，则进一步标注插入锚点，从而在行级粒度上恢复手稿真实的非线性阅读顺序——据我们所知，这是历史阿拉伯语手稿语料库中首次发布此类标注。由于参考转写完全标音，而手稿笔迹通常无变音符，我们同时发布了原始标音转写和去变音符的对应版本。
tldr: 该论文首次发布了最大规模的历史阿拉伯语手稿行级数据集AraMS-28k，并引入了行级插入锚点标注，以恢复非线性阅读顺序，同时提供标音与去标音两种转写版本。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AraMS-28k, the largest publicly available line-level dataset of historical Arabic manuscripts, featuring novel insertion-anchor annotations to recover non-linear reading order, with both vocalized and diacritic-normalized transcriptions.
